title: Vintage Harkerware Currier & Ives Homestead In Winter 6.25" Saucer Bread Plate
descriptionText:
Vintage Harkerware Currier & Ives "Homestead In Winter" Saucer or Bread Plate

A charming piece of American pottery history from Harker Pottery Co.,
featuring the classic Currier & Ives winter homestead scene in blue
transferware on a white ground with trim.

- Pattern: Currier & Ives - Homestead In Winter
- Maker: Harkerware (Harker Pottery Co., USA)
- Size: 6 1/4" diameter saucer or bread plate
- Use: Display, collection, or everyday dinnerware

A great addition to a Currier & Ives collection, or to mix into a vintage
farmhouse table setting. Please check photos closely for exact condition -
ask any questions before buying.
